prompt: imagemagick remap colormap precision bit depth limit
answer:
ImageMagick’s `-remap` option limits the remap image colormap to **8 bits of precision**. Separately, ImageMagick supports a maximum of **65,535 colors**; if exceeded, it reduces the number of unique colors below that limit.

Sources:
- [ImageMagick command-line options](https://imagemagick.org/command-line-options/)
- [ImageMagick GitHub discussion](https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/discussions/7525)
